BillHeading.BriefDescription: Establishing a minimum font size for state agency communications to the public.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to establishing a minimum font size for state agency communications to the public; and adding a new section to chapter 42.30 RCW.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 1. A new section is added to chapter 42.30 RCW to read as follows:
BillSection.P: Any communication distributed to the public by a state agency, as defined in RCW 42.56.010, including but not limited to letters, notices, citations, flyers, postcards, and newsletters, must use a minimum of 10 point type and a recommended accessible font, such as Times New Roman, Verdana, Arial, Tahoma, Helvetica, or Calibri fonts. If needed, eight point type is acceptable for tables.
